title: Subagent drawer navigation, 100% White Paper compliance, and CortexExplorer polish
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Fixed subagent drawer view navigation and White Paper compliance. Replaced all dark obsidian styles on subagent cards with pure White Paper styling and subtle role badges. Added prominent breadcrumbs <Parent Task Title> / <Subagent Task Title> with role badge and 'К задаче' back button in DrawerHeader. Updated DrawerActivityStream to display atomic subagent prompt and [← К родительской задаче] return button. Updated DrawerSteerBar with [СУБАГЕНТ: <ROLE>] badge, subagent steer placeholder, and return button. Removed backlog/ready chips in CortexExplorer StageHeaderButton and hid agent dropdown on ready/terminal columns in ColumnStageCard. Added bidirectional toolIdToSubagentId mapping and auto-resolution in drawerStore.ts and AgentConsoleDrawer.
